name: Decrees
overview: Scripture reveals that decrees carry divine and earthly authority, exemplified by the irrevocable nature of the Medes and Persians’ laws, as seen when the king acknowledges that no decree can be altered (Daniel 6:15). The early church in Jerusalem also issued ecclesiastical decrees, guided by the Holy Spirit, to instruct believers on essential practices such as abstaining from certain foods and immoral behavior (Acts 15:28-29). These decrees were then communicated by the apostles and elders for the churches to observe, underscoring the importance of submission to godly authority within the Christian community (Acts 16:4).
